svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lid: the outer drum's own lid. Cut a 150 mm hole in the middle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (jigsaw with a metal blade, file to a scribed circle).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Collar: a strip of 1.5 mm sheet 40 mm wide plus six tabs 15 wide x

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 long along one edge. Roll it round a piece of the 160 mm throat

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pipe so it fits the pipe snugly, and rivet the overlap.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold the six tabs out flat. Stand the collar on the lid centred on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the hole, drill through each tab and the lid 4.9 mm, rivet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The throat stands on the 5 mm ring of lid inside the collar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue ceramic gasket rope in the lid's rim channel with sealant.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 160 mm pipe slides into the collar by hand, with no gap

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wider than 1 mm, and sits flat on the lid.
